description: dd_colouring §5 unit test 1: the round trip sRGB → linear → OKLab → linear → sRGB in f32 through render::colour::space, at every 8-bit sRGB code that is a multiple of 5 on each channel (52 codes per channel, 140608 colours, black, white, the primaries and the secondaries among them).
